title: Contraction on the orthogonal subspace
statement: Let $A$ be a real $n\times n$ symmetric matrix with nonnegative entries and row sums equal to $1$, and define $\lambda(A)$ as the supremum of $\|Au\|$ over unit vectors orthogonal to the constant vector whose entries are $1/n$. For every vector $v$ orthogonal to that constant vector, $\|Av\|\le \lambda(A)\|v\|$.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is orthogonal to the constant vector with entries $1/n$
